How to play

the modes, the rules, the money

UMD

what this is

You are the corner, not the fighter. Build a machine out of Clevis robot parts — real links, real weights — pick how it fights, and shout at it during the round. The coaching happens between rounds: the fight stops, the round comes back to you as the three or four things that actually happened, and what you say becomes what the brain is trained on before the next round.

A fight runs until a machine is destroyed, the referee stops a machine that is down and not defending itself, or you throw the towel. There are no judges and no last round.

1–6 shout · Enter seconds out · drag to orbit · wheel to zoom · Esc closes anything open

Every ? in the app explains the instrument beside it. Every number the fight runs on is in the rulebook.
